ms.report:
Dear reviewer, thank you for your comments. We have adjusted the project accordingly:
・The app will now display the IPFS hash of the uploaded images
・The video is more detailed and shows how to verify that images were uploaded to IPFS
・We've added a brief description of the test cases: https://github.com/WingRiders/nft-forge/blob/main/docs/tests.md

Your suggestion to display all images uploaded by a user does not align with the IPFS protocol. In the IPFS network, anyone can upload files, but they are not associated with a specific user in any way. Therefore, it is not possible to determine which files were uploaded by whom. Additionally, files in IPFS are identified by their content hash, meaning that if multiple users upload the same file, it will only be stored once in the network.
Please note that the current state of the application is focused solely on demonstrating the image upload functionality. Once the next screens for NFT minting are implemented, the overall flow will be slightly different. Regarding your issue with installing Bun dependencies, it appears to be a permission-related problem with your Bun/Node.js installation. Please ensure that Bun and Node.js are correctly installed for your user and have the appropriate permissions. Here is the milestone evidence:
